description: Unified batch availability for picker / batch-to-batch transfer. Part of the Availability APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

isVariant.description: Is variant query parameter. Default: false.

noStock.description: No stock query parameter. Default: false.

excludeBatchUniqueName.description: Exclude batch unique name query parameter.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint).

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: expiryDate.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc.
